'''Reach''' is an [[enchantment]] added by [[Matcha Flavoured]] that lets the wearer place and break blocks from farther away.

== Obtaining ==
The [[Prayer of Will]], crafted from a [[Hell-Bound Book]] and four [[Stable Void]]s, gives Reach I. No source gives a higher level, but as with any enchantment, two items with the same level can be combined in an [[anvil]] for the next level, up to Reach III.

In 1.12.2 the prayer stores the old <code>main:reach</code>, which turns into Reach the first tick the chestplate is worn.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/main/item_modifier/update_reach.json}}</ref> The converted level is added to any Reach the chestplate already has, so applying the prayer to a chestplate with Reach III gives Reach IV.

== Behavior ==
A chestplate with Reach adds 2 blocks per level to the wearer's block interaction range (the <code>block_interaction_range</code> attribute), so Reach I raises it from the default 4.5 to 6.5 blocks. It does not change the range for attacking entities.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/enchantment/reach.json}}</ref>

Its anvil cost multiplier is 0.
